references.context: Choose Evil Dead 1. Plunge at the roving lit GROOVY target.
references.label: GROOVY in-line targets
references.description: The six targets run vertically along the left-middle side of the playfield.

references.context: Prepare Cabin Multiball. Knock down the Cabin drops and shoot the Cabin VUK to lock a ball. Repeat until the next lock will start the multiball.
references.label: Cabin lock VUK
references.description: The lock entrance is through the cabin window in the upper-left-center area.

references.context: Build the scoring multipliers. Complete GROOVY in order, complete the three Blood Flood targets, and prepare the Dagger multiplier.
references.label: Blood Flood targets
references.description: The three standup targets sit inside the upper pop-bumper nest.

references.context: Shoot the scoop under the right ramp to start Undying Love. Then hit the left ramp and right ramp in either order.
references.label: Mode-start scoop
references.description: The scoop is below the right ramp entrance on the right half of the playfield.

references.context: Shoot the open Cellar Door. On the lower playfield, make five loops to dig the grave. This starts two-ball play.
references.label: Cellar Door
references.description: The motorized door is in the center, directly above the clear lower-playfield window.
